name: listEvents
title: Events
description: Lists the editions of the conference with their dates, city and state.

name: getEvent
title: Event details
description: Gives an event with its dates, venue, tracks and the number of people registered.

name: createEvent
title: Create an event
description: Creates a new edition of the conference as a draft, with its name and dates.

name: updateEventDates
title: Change the event dates
description: Moves the first and last day of an event that is still a draft or published.

name: publishEvent
title: Publish an event
description: Makes an event and its agenda visible on the public site and opens registration.

name: unpublishEvent
title: Unpublish an event
description: Takes an event off the public site; registrations already made are kept.

name: postponeEvent
title: Postpone an event
description: Marks an event as postponed without new dates and tells everyone registered.

name: cancelEvent
title: Cancel an event
description: Cancels an event, closes registration and tells speakers, sponsors and everyone registered.

name: archiveEvent
title: Archive an event
description: Moves a past event to the archive, read only, with its agenda and recordings.

name: cloneEvent
title: Copy an event
description: Creates a draft from an earlier event with the same tracks, rooms and pass types, and no people.

name: listVenues
title: Venues
description: Lists the venues the conference has used or may use, with their city and number of rooms.

name: getVenue
title: Venue details
description: Gives a venue with its address, contact, rooms and access notes.

name: addVenue
title: Add a venue
description: Records a new venue with its address and contact person.

name: updateVenueContact
title: Change the venue contact
description: Changes the contact person, phone or e-mail of a venue.

name: retireVenue
title: Retire a venue
description: Stops offering a venue for new events; past events keep it.

name: listRooms
title: Rooms
description: Lists the rooms of a venue with their capacity, floor and equipment.

name: getRoom
title: Room details
description: Gives a room with its capacity, equipment and the sessions held in it.

name: addRoom
title: Add a room
description: Adds a meeting room to a venue with its capacity and floor.

name: setRoomCapacity
title: Set the room capacity
description: Changes the number of seats of a meeting room, for example after a new layout.

name: closeRoom
title: Close a room
description: Takes a meeting room out of use for a period, for works or a private use.

name: reopenRoom
title: Reopen a room
description: Puts a closed meeting room back in use.

name: bookRoom
title: Book a room
description: Holds a meeting room for a slot that is not a session, such as a rehearsal or a press briefing.

name: releaseRoom
title: Release a room booking
description: Frees a slot booked in a meeting room.

name: listTracks
title: Tracks
description: Lists the tracks of an event with their chair and number of sessions.

name: createTrack
title: Create a track
description: Adds a themed track to an event.

name: renameTrack
title: Rename a track
description: Changes the name or description of a track.

name: mergeTracks
title: Merge tracks
description: Moves every session of one track into another and removes the first.

name: deleteTrack
title: Delete a track
description: Removes an empty track from an event.

name: assignTrackChair
title: Assign a track chair
description: Names the person who chairs a track and decides its programme.

name: listSessions
title: Sessions
description: Lists the sessions of an event with their slot, room, track and speakers.

name: getSession
title: Session details
description: Gives a session with its abstract, slot, room, speakers and seats taken.

name: createSession
title: Create a session
description: Adds a talk, panel or workshop to the agenda in a slot and a room.

name: rescheduleSession
title: Reschedule a session
description: Moves a session to another day or time, keeping its room when it is free.

name: moveSessionRoom
title: Move a session to another room
description: Puts a session in another room at the same time.

name: extendSession
title: Extend a session
description: Makes a session longer by a number of minutes when the room is free after it.

name: shortenSession
title: Shorten a session
description: Makes a session shorter by a number of minutes.

name: cancelSession
title: Cancel a session
description: Removes a session from the agenda and tells the people who saved it.

name: splitSession
title: Split a session
description: Cuts a long session into two parts with a break between them.

name: mergeSessions
title: Merge sessions
description: Joins two sessions of the same track into one slot, keeping all speakers.

name: setSessionCapacity
title: Set the session capacity
description: Limits the number of seats people can reserve for a session, below the room size.

name: publishSession
title: Publish a session
description: Shows a session on the public agenda.

name: lockSession
title: Lock a session
description: Stops changes to a session so its slot and speakers stay as printed.

name: listSpeakers
title: Speakers
description: Lists the speakers of an event with their sessions and state.

name: getSpeaker
title: Speaker details
description: Gives a speaker with their bio, photo, sessions and travel.

name: inviteSpeaker
title: Invite a speaker
description: Sends an invitation to speak in a session.

name: confirmSpeaker
title: Confirm a speaker
description: Marks an invited speaker as confirmed for their session.

name: declineSpeaker
title: Record a speaker decline
description: Records that an invited speaker said no and frees their place in the session.

name: replaceSpeaker
title: Replace a speaker
description: Puts another person in place of a speaker in a session.

name: removeSpeaker
title: Remove a speaker
description: Takes a speaker off a session.

name: updateSpeakerBio
title: Update a speaker bio
description: Changes the bio, photo or job title shown for a speaker.

name: setSpeakerTravel
title: Set speaker travel
description: Records the flights, arrival and hotel nights of a speaker.

name: listSubmissions
title: Submissions
description: Lists the talk proposals sent to the call for papers with their track and state.

state.description: submitted, accepted, rejected, waitlisted or withdrawn

name: getSubmission
title: Submission details
description: Gives a talk proposal with its abstract, authors, reviews and history.

name: createSubmission
title: Create a submission
description: Records a talk proposal for an author, as the call for papers form does.

name: reviseSubmission
title: Revise a submission
description: Changes the title, abstract or authors of a proposal before the decision.

name: withdrawSubmission
title: Withdraw a submission
description: Takes back a proposal at the request of its author.

name: acceptSubmission
title: Accept a submission
description: Accepts a proposal and tells its authors; a session can then be made from it.

name: rejectSubmission
title: Reject a submission
description: Turns down a proposal and tells its authors.

name: waitlistSubmission
title: Waitlist a submission
description: Keeps a proposal in reserve in case an accepted talk drops out.

name: reopenSubmission
title: Reopen a submission
description: Puts a decided proposal back to submitted so it can be judged again.

name: assignSubmissionTrack
title: Assign a submission to a track
description: Puts a proposal in the track whose chair will judge it.

name: flagSubmissionConflict
title: Flag a conflict of interest
description: Marks that a reviewer must not judge a proposal, for example a colleague of an author.

name: listReviews
title: Reviews
description: Lists the reviews of the proposals of a track with their score and reviewer.

name: assignReviewer
title: Assign a reviewer
description: Asks a reviewer to judge a proposal.

name: unassignReviewer
title: Unassign a reviewer
description: Takes a proposal off the list of a reviewer.

name: submitReview
title: Submit a review
description: Records the score and comments of a reviewer on a proposal.

name: updateReview
title: Update a review
description: Changes the score or comments of a review already given.

name: remindReviewers
title: Remind reviewers
description: Sends a reminder to the reviewers who still have proposals to judge.

name: getReviewScores
title: Review scores
description: Gives the average score and spread of the reviews of each proposal, to help the decision.

name: getCallForPapers
title: Call for papers
description: Gives the call for papers of an event with its dates, tracks and number of proposals.

name: openCallForPapers
title: Open the call for papers
description: Starts taking talk proposals until a closing date.

name: closeCallForPapers
title: Close the call for papers
description: Stops taking talk proposals now.

name: extendCallForPapers
title: Extend the call for papers
description: Moves the closing date of the call for papers later.

name: listRegistrations
title: Registrations
description: Lists the people registered for an event with their pass type and state.

name: getRegistration
title: Registration details
description: Gives a registration with the attendee, pass type, sessions saved and check-in.

name: registerAttendee
title: Register an attendee
description: Registers a person for an event on a pass type.

name: transferRegistration
title: Transfer a registration
description: Gives a registration to another person who will come instead.

name: cancelRegistration
title: Cancel a registration
description: Cancels the place of an attendee and frees it for the waitlist.

name: upgradeRegistration
title: Change the pass of a registration
description: Moves a registration to another pass type, for example from one day to the full event.

name: confirmRegistration
title: Confirm a registration
description: Confirms a pending registration, for example once its company approved it.

name: resendConfirmation
title: Resend the confirmation
description: Sends the confirmation e-mail of a registration again.

name: checkInAttendee
title: Check in an attendee
description: Marks an attendee as arrived at the venue.

name: undoCheckIn
title: Undo a check-in
description: Removes a check-in recorded by mistake.

name: listPassTypes
title: Pass types
description: Lists the pass types of an event with their days, seats and how many are taken.

name: createPassType
title: Create a pass type
description: Adds a pass type, such as one day, full event or student, with its seats.

name: setPassCapacity
title: Set the pass capacity
description: Changes how many registrations a pass type allows.

name: closePassType
title: Close a pass type
description: Stops new registrations on a pass type; those made are kept.

name: listWaitlist
title: Waitlist
description: Lists the people waiting for a place, in order, for an event or a session.

name: addToWaitlist
title: Add to the waitlist
description: Puts a person on the waitlist of an event or a full session.

name: promoteFromWaitlist
title: Give a place from the waitlist
description: Gives a freed place to the next person on the waitlist, or to the one named.

name: removeFromWaitlist
title: Remove from the waitlist
description: Takes a person off the waitlist.

name: listBadges
title: Badges
description: Lists the badges printed for an event and those still to print.

name: printBadge
title: Print a badge
description: Prints the name badge of an attendee, speaker or staff member.

name: reprintBadge
title: Reprint a badge
description: Prints a badge again after a loss or a change of name.

name: voidBadge
title: Void a badge
description: Makes a badge unusable at the doors, for example after a cancellation.

name: listSponsors
title: Sponsors
description: Lists the sponsors of an event with their level, booth and state.

name: getSponsor
title: Sponsor details
description: Gives a sponsor with its level, contact, booth and passes included.

name: addSponsor
title: Add a sponsor
description: Records a sponsor for an event at a level.

name: changeSponsorLevel
title: Change the sponsor level
description: Moves a sponsor to a higher or lower level.

name: renewSponsor
title: Renew a sponsor
description: Carries a sponsor of a past event over to the next one at the same level.

name: dropSponsor
title: Drop a sponsor
description: Removes a sponsor from an event and frees its booth.

name: assignBooth
title: Assign a booth
description: Gives a sponsor a booth in the exhibit hall.

name: releaseBooth
title: Release a booth
description: Takes a booth back from a sponsor.

name: listBooths
title: Booths
description: Lists the booths of the exhibit hall with their size and the sponsor in each.

name: getBooth
title: Booth details
description: Gives a booth with its size, power, place on the floor plan and sponsor.

name: listVolunteers
title: Volunteers
description: Lists the volunteers of an event with their shifts and hours.

name: enrolVolunteer
title: Enrol a volunteer
description: Adds a person to the volunteer team of an event.

name: assignVolunteerShift
title: Assign a volunteer shift
description: Puts a volunteer on a shift.

name: swapVolunteerShift
title: Swap volunteer shifts
description: Exchanges the shifts of two volunteers.

name: releaseVolunteer
title: Release a volunteer
description: Takes a person off the volunteer team and frees their shifts.

name: listShifts
title: Shifts
description: Lists the volunteer shifts of an event with their post, time and people still needed.

name: createShift
title: Create a shift
description: Adds a volunteer shift at a post, such as the doors or the cloakroom.

name: cancelShift
title: Cancel a shift
description: Removes a volunteer shift and tells the volunteers on it.

name: listMeals
title: Meals
description: Lists the meals and coffee breaks of an event with their time and headcount.

name: scheduleMeal
title: Schedule a meal
description: Adds a lunch, dinner or coffee break to the catering plan.

name: setMealHeadcount
title: Set the meal headcount
description: Changes the number of people the caterer prepares a meal for.

name: cancelMeal
title: Cancel a meal
description: Removes a meal from the catering plan and tells the caterer.

name: listDietaryNeeds
title: Dietary needs
description: Counts the dietary needs declared at registration, such as vegetarian or no nuts.

name: listRoomBlocks
title: Hotel room blocks
description: Lists the blocks of hotel rooms held for an event with nights and rooms taken.

name: reserveRoomBlock
title: Reserve a hotel room block
description: Holds a number of hotel rooms for some nights at a hotel near the venue.

name: extendRoomBlock
title: Extend a hotel room block
description: Adds nights or rooms to a hotel block.

name: releaseRoomBlock
title: Release a hotel room block
description: Gives the unused rooms of a hotel block back to the hotel.

name: assignHotelRoom
title: Assign a hotel room
description: Gives a speaker or staff member a room from a hotel block for their nights.

name: listAnnouncements
title: Announcements
description: Lists the e-mails and notices sent or planned for an event.

name: sendAnnouncement
title: Send an announcement
description: Sends an e-mail now to everyone registered, the speakers, the sponsors or the volunteers.

name: scheduleAnnouncement
title: Schedule an announcement
description: Plans an e-mail to go out to an audience at a later time.

name: cancelAnnouncement
title: Cancel an announcement
description: Stops a planned e-mail before it goes out.

name: listEmailTemplates
title: E-mail templates
description: Lists the templates of the automatic e-mails, such as the registration confirmation.

name: updateEmailTemplate
title: Update an e-mail template
description: Changes the subject or text of an automatic e-mail.

name: createSurvey
title: Create a survey
description: Writes a feedback survey with its questions, for an event or a session.

name: sendSurvey
title: Send a survey
description: Sends a feedback survey to the attendees who checked in.

name: closeSurvey
title: Close a survey
description: Stops taking answers to a survey.

name: getSurveyResults
title: Survey results
description: Gives the answers to a survey, question by question.

name: getSessionRatings
title: Session ratings
description: Gives the stars attendees gave each session, with their comments.

name: uploadSlides
title: Upload slides
description: Attaches the slides of a speaker to their session.

name: getSlides
title: Slides
description: Gives the slides attached to a session for download.

name: listRecordings
title: Recordings
description: Lists the video recordings of the sessions and whether they are public.

name: publishRecording
title: Publish a recording
description: Puts the video of a session on the public site.

name: unpublishRecording
title: Unpublish a recording
description: Takes the video of a session off the public site, for example at the speaker's request.

name: getAgenda
title: Agenda
description: Gives the whole agenda of an event, day by day and room by room.

name: exportAgenda
title: Export the agenda
description: Writes the agenda as a calendar file or a printable PDF.

name: freezeAgenda
title: Freeze the agenda
description: Stops every change to the agenda before it goes to print.

name: unfreezeAgenda
title: Unfreeze the agenda
description: Allows changes to a frozen agenda again.

name: findScheduleConflicts
title: Schedule conflicts
description: Finds speakers in two sessions at once, rooms booked twice and sessions over the room size.

name: getAttendanceCount
title: Attendance
description: Gives how many people registered, checked in and did not come, per day.

name: getSessionAttendance
title: Session attendance
description: Gives how many people were in each session, from the door scans.

name: getRegistrationTrend
title: Registration trend
description: Gives the registrations made each week since registration opened, against the last edition.

name: listStaff
title: Staff
description: Lists the organisers who can use this back office, with their role.

name: inviteStaff
title: Invite a staff member
description: Gives a person access to the back office with a role.

name: setStaffRole
title: Change a staff role
description: Changes what an organiser may do in the back office.

name: revokeStaff
title: Revoke staff access
description: Removes the access of an organiser to the back office.

name: listShuttles
title: Shuttles
description: Lists the shuttle buses between the venue, the hotels and the airport.

name: scheduleShuttle
title: Schedule a shuttle
description: Adds a shuttle run between two stops at a time.

name: cancelShuttle
title: Cancel a shuttle
description: Removes a shuttle run and tells the people who booked a seat.

name: listAudienceQuestions
title: Audience questions
description: Lists the questions the audience sent during a session, with their votes.

name: approveAudienceQuestion
title: Approve an audience question
description: Shows a question from the audience on the screen of the session.

name: hideAudienceQuestion
title: Hide an audience question
description: Hides a question from the audience, for example off topic or rude.

name: listCertificates
title: Attendance certificates
description: Lists the certificates of attendance issued for an event.

name: issueCertificate
title: Issue a certificate
description: Writes a certificate of attendance for an attendee who checked in.

name: revokeCertificate
title: Revoke a certificate
description: Cancels a certificate of attendance issued by mistake.
